title: AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
description: Persist an item to a DynamoDB table from a Lambda function, triggering a Kinesis Data Stream.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys a Lambda function, a DynamoDB table and a Kinesis Data Stream.
This is a Java 25 implementation of this pattern.
